Why AI visibility matters now: a growing share of people looking for a dance studio ask ChatGPT, Gemini, or Google's AI overview before they ever open a map. Studios that don't structure their site for those tools simply don't get mentioned — regardless of how good the studio actually is. In our checks, every studio the AI engines named was inside Pasadena itself — none of the six studios in Alhambra, Arcadia or Monrovia came up.

Methodology: the field is every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Pasadena dance searches on 18 Oct 2026. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). Google lists Super Ballroom Dance Studio under two names (it also appears as Ballroom Dancing LA); it's rated once. ChatGPT also named Evelyn Meinz Ballroom Dance, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons pasadena ca, dance lessons pasadena ca, salsa lessons pasadena ca and wedding dance lessons pasadena ca). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. This is an independent measurement by Ballroom Dance Directory, not commissioned by any studio named above. Rankings reflect a point-in-time snapshot and will be re-run periodically. The complete scorecard, Google table and AI answers are in the detailed report.

In Pasadena, 14 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 14 dance and ballroom studios serving the Pasadena market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 54 to 89. The AI engines name only five of the 14, and all six studios in Alhambra, Arcadia and Monrovia were never named once. The field averages 72 (C) on AI readiness, 13 of 14 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 7 of 14 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 18 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Pasadena, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 14 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Super Ballroom Dance Studio (89) and Fred Astaire Dance Studios Alhambra (87) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 54. One score is shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 72 (C) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • Of the 14 studios, 13 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 7 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • All 14 studios have images without alt text, from 1 of 51 images to 68 of 142 — easy points every site in the field is leaving on the table.
  • Two of the 14 are franchise locations (one Arthur Murray and one Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #14 is 35 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Pasadena.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve Pasadena from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is. No studio in this field has all of that yet.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (14 studios): ballroomdancingla.com, fredastaire.com/alhambra, arthurmurraypasadena.com, dancestreet.us, salsaybachatapasadena.com, dancearoundtheclock.com, crownpasadena.com, pbda.dance, amgdance.com, sonataroom.com, letsdancesp.com, lindygroove.com, thegranadala.com, lailaiballroom.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 18 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Pasadena dance searches. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). Google lists Super Ballroom Dance Studio under two names (it also appears as Ballroom Dancing LA); it's rated once. ChatGPT also named Evelyn Meinz Ballroom Dance, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Left out: Studio One Ballroom (its website has expired), Igor Malyshev (a private instructor), and the ballet, youth, contemporary and fitness studios that lead the broad answers (Elements Dance Space, Athletic Garage, Unbound, Pasadena Civic Ballet, Pasadena Dance Theatre, Lumina Academy).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 18 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Pasadena, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Pasadena, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini in temporary, unpersonalized chats, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 18 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons pasadena ca”; “dance lessons pasadena ca”; “salsa lessons pasadena ca”; “wedding dance lessons pasadena ca”; “ballroom dance lessons alhambra ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in pasadena ca” and “ballroom dance studio pasadena”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
